english.note: Use this colloquial noun for audacity or nerve when the speaker is criticizing the person's cheek or foolhardiness.

examples.english: You’ve got some brass, saying that in front of the boss!
examples.traditional: 你真係有狗膽，敢喺老闆面前咁講！
